quick: Casirivimab 600 mg + imdevimab 600 mg as a single dose
summary: Casirivimab and imdevimab are two monoclonal antibodies against the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, given together. They do not neutralise Omicron variants, and the US authorisation was limited in 2022 for that reason. They are unlikely to work against currently circulating variants.
indications: COVID-19 treatment or prophylaxis only where the circulating variant is known to be susceptible

dosage.d: Casirivimab 600 mg + imdevimab 600 mg as a single dose
dosage.n: Higher doses were used for hospitalised seronegative patients

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Bind non-overlapping epitopes of the spike receptor-binding domain, blocking ACE2 binding.

relative: Circulating variants not susceptible (Omicron and later)

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
